```{r mermaid-setup, include = FALSE}
# Renders ```{mermaid} chunks (or chunks with `file = "diagrams/*.mmd"`) as
# <pre class="mermaid"> blocks; mermaid.js (loaded below) draws them in the browser.
knitr::knit_engines$set(mermaid = function(options) {
  code <- paste(options$code, collapse = "\n")
  paste0(
    "\n```{=html}\n<pre class=\"mermaid\">\n",
    htmltools::htmlEscape(code),
    "\n</pre>\n```\n"
  )
})
```

```{=html}
<script type="module">
  import mermaid from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11/dist/mermaid.esm.min.mjs";
  mermaid.initialize({ startOnLoad: true, theme: "neutral", securityLevel: "strict" });
</script>
```
